blocks.html: For car racers, there's nothing better than feeling that adrenaline that comes with revving your engine and smelling your tires heat up the pavement. But not all racers sit on the driver's seat--others hold a remote control and have the best time drifting a radio-controlled (or RC) car. If you're one of the latter, you'll be glad to know that Robinsons Galleria in Ortigas, Quezon City is having a three-day competition to officially launch the newest RC Tracks Galleria that side of Metro Manila. Check it out from February 25 to 27, 2022 at the third floor of the mall beside Comic Odyssey.

The RC Tracks Galleria Year Kick-Off Competition is officially happening on February 25. This will be followed by the Drift Competition on February 26, and the Rally Club Competition on February 27. Renowned RC groups in the Philippines like RC Rally PH, Manila On-Road RC, Philippine RC Drifters, and Meralco RC Club are joining in on the fun. All events are open for spectators for free, you can even bring your own RC car to try out the tracks during contest breaks. After the three-day event, Robinsons Galleria's newest tracks can be used for free every day during mall hours.

“At Robinsons Malls, we want our customers to have unique experiences that will make their mall visit more worthwhile and delightful. The RC Tracks at Robinsons Galleria is one of our major initiatives to promote an active lifestyle and support our RC communities looking for a safe and fun venue to pursue their hobbies”, says Arlene G. Magtibay, SVP and General Manager of Robinsons Malls.

Touted as the first RC Multi-track inside a mall in the country, RC Tracks Galleria meets the requirements of a professional track, which means you can use it to practice for your next big competition. But don't fret if you're just getting into the game as it's also open to newbie racers and casual racers. The new indoor attraction also features two kinds of race tracks: A Rally Track for those who feel the need for speed, and a Drift Track for those who want to drive in style.

After a round or two on the tracks, you can drop by in any of Robinsons Galleria's restaurants to wind down. Robinsons will soon have an RC car rental, where enthusiasts can borrow an RC car for free. This will be accessible through the RMalls+ App, where you can claim a voucher for RC Tracks Galleria. Download the RMalls+ App now and enjoy a lot of other exciting perks in Galleria like free parking, free VIP lounge use, exclusive discounts and more! Other events in the pipeline are RC Rally and RC Drift classes for the newbies, and more races throughout the year.
So what are you waiting for? Dust off that RC car and get ready to battle it out in the newest indoor RC track in Quezon City.
